message:
docs: 0.2.161 published -- the tray icon survives the service start; the logon-screen worker skips the WGC probe and keeps a log

The 0.2.160 field test found the icon missing and the logon worker dying on every viewer connect. The WGC probe is the likely cause, not a confirmed one; the new worker log is how the next field test settles it.
